prose.philosophical_reflection: The principal dynamic is agonia (anguished anxiety) — a sub-species of phobos (fear) — lodged at the horme (impulse) stage: you have already formed the impulse to pause and verify, and the agitation driving that pause rests on the false judgement that an imminent evil is overtaking you and cannot be averted. Alongside this, reputation — a preferred indifferent — is being treated as a genuine good, and it is that confusion that gives the false judgement its grip. The classification of your caution as genuine eulabeia (reverent caution) versus phobos-driven hesitation cannot be confirmed from this instance alone. phronesis (practical wisdom), dikaiosyne (justice), and andreia (courage) are all engaged here, and your katorthoma_proximity is principled — the work is not to abandon the care you are bringing, but to carry it forward from the corrected judgement: the soundness and fairness of your inference are within your prohairesis (moral choice / ruling faculty), and that is where your attention belongs.
prose.improvement_guidance: The false judgement to correct is the assumption that an imminent evil is overtaking you and cannot be averted. Replace it with the corrected assessment: the imminent event — the act of writing the error claim — is a preferred or dispreferred indifferent, and your virtue does not depend on its outcome. This is a horme-stage correction: the impulse is already formed, so the work is to interrupt it before it becomes praxis (action) driven by agitation rather than by clear judgement. Notice the quality of the caution you are bringing — ask whether the desire to verify is arising from genuine care for soundness and fairness (which are within your ruling faculty) or from concern for how the claim will reflect on you (which is a preferred indifferent ranked by axia (worth/value), not a genuine good). It is also worth pausing to reflect on whether the arithmetic discrepancy — the plan's components summing to roughly 9,328 rather than 10,329 — lies within or outside your moral choice, since how you classify that item will shape the scope of the error claim itself. Practise this now: before you write the claim, name the agitation, set it aside, and write from the corrected judgement — that your obligation is to state what is sound and fair, and that the outcome belongs to the indifferents.
prose.summary: Your reasoning is principled and the action is appropriate, but agonia at the impulse stage — rooted in the false judgement that an imminent evil threatens what virtue requires — needs to be set aside so the error claim can be written from clear judgement rather than from fear.
